subject: Monolith Bank: post-upgrade surge & output drift
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika@monolithbank.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: joe.lin@monolithbank.com
Date: 2026-10-26T14:03:12Z
Subject: Urgent: Observing P99 surge + hallucination rate after upgrade

Kimberly —

We rolled the v4.2 model and q2 quant profile today during the 01:00 UTC deploy. Since ~13:30 UTC we're seeing a steep p99 latency increase (from ~280ms to ~1.8s), token timeouts on large prompts, and an uptick in incorrect entity hallucinations in our payments flow (~4% -> ~12%). This is customer-impacting — several payment authorizations are delayed and one customer reported an inconsistent beneficiary name.

I've attached a small slice of error logs and a sample request/response pair. Please advise immediate mitigations; our ops team is ready to coordinate. We need either a rollback or a mitigation path within 2 hours.

Attachments: error-logs-20261026.txt, sample-response.json (inline)

Thanks,
Anika Shah
Head of Platform Reliability
Monolith Bank
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Anika Shah <anika@monolithbank.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-26T14:16:02Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: Observing P99 surge + hallucination rate after upgrade

Anika — thank you for the alert and the logs. We're pulling an emergency triage now.

Immediate asks:
- Please keep traffic steady (no further feature flags) — we'll advise routing if needed.
- I've asked engineering to analyze traces; will we be able to share 1:1 production request ids?

Immediate mitigation options being evaluated: fallback to pinned v4.1 variant for Monolith (no auth changes) or restrict q2 quant profile to a smaller batch window. Both options are low-risk. We'll propose a safe rollback within 90 minutes if we can't stabilize.

Scheduling an emergency call at 14:45 UTC — priyom, marcus, grace: pls join and bring traces + kernel run logs. Vivek, can you please check capacity routing options?

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Customer Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-26T14:28:35Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: Observing P99 surge + hallucination rate after upgrade

On analysis of the p99 traces (attached p99-traces-20261026.zip):
- We see a pattern of KV cache churn for long-context requests. v4.2's attention optimizations increase memory pressure under q2; as a result, there are more cache-miss flushes leading to repeated reloads and decode stalls at token boundaries.
- Additionally, the quantized decode kernel (q2) is showing higher variance on logits for certain token classes — that plausibly explains the spike in entity hallucinations.
- Error logs show an increase in 504/timeouts correlating with the stalls. CPU on CPU-hosted steering services is within normal range (so not a backpressure upstream).

Recommendation (priority):
1) Immediate: route Monolith traffic to the v4.1-stable model variant (config change) — avoids the q2 kernel path.
2) Near term: reduce q2 batch window and enable per-request decode-timeout safeguard.
3) Postmortem: deep kernel telemetry to compare quant rounding on entity tokens.

Attaching: p99-traces-20261026.zip, short kernel-run-samples.txt.

—Marcus
Senior Inference Engineer
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-26T14:33:50Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: Observing P99 surge + hallucination rate after upgrade

Kimberly / Team —
I can enact two tactical steps while Marcus prepares rollback:
- Spin up a dedicated pool in us-east-1 with v4.1 pinned for Monolith traffic and route 100% of their production prefix there (estimated 6–9 minutes to warm).
- Apply a temporary per-request token timeout (1.8s) and reduce batch window from 8ms to 4ms for specific routes to reduce latency spikes.

I will schedule a config push at 14:55 UTC pending your go. If we need a full rollback of the deploy across regions, I request executive sign-off for an emergency cross-team incident (affects deployment schedule).

—Vivek
Head of Platform Operations

Subject: Executive brief: Monolith Bank production degradation (v4.2 / q2) — request for credits & priority handling

Team — FYI and requesting guidance/approval. Quick summary:
- Impact: Monolith Bank (large payments customer) experienced increased p99 latency (avg 280ms -> peak 1.8s) and a rise in entity hallucination rate impacting payment authorizations after our v4.2 + q2 quant rollout at 01:00 UTC.
- Actions taken: routed traffic to v4.1-stable in a dedicated pool, reduced batch windows, applied per-request decode timeouts, and began kernel telemetry capture.
- Current status: customer now on stable variant; partial mitigation successful; ongoing telemetry collection.
- Customer asks: SLA credits plus a timeline for root cause and permanent fixes. Procurement looped in.

Requesting: executive sign-off to offer a credits package (starting proposal: 5% credit for October invoice) and priority engineer time to complete kernel-level investigation. This is a strategic account for our payments vertical.

Relevant links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9876 (incident), HS:123456 (Monolith account).
